418892de7d3cf5d6.statement: Page uses semantic landmark elements (e.g., header, nav, main, section, footer, aside) to structure content.

Uses semantic inline elements such as <q> for quotes, plus many <small> and <strong> for metadata, and an ordered list.

e8f0ce348c9c89b9.statement: Images carry descriptive alt text for meaningful images and empty alt for decorative icons or thumbnails.
Images mostly have empty alt attributes, even for content photos, avatars and icons.

524bab0f738ed3f7.statement: Layout is a single-column stack of full-width sections, each with centered content, with no sidebar.

262f94c73a5c2e1f.statement: Header is compact with a small logo and single-row navigation/links alongside it.
Header logo is rendered prominently at a larger size.

78641d5cbfecdd84.statement: Hero is a two-column split with text on one side and a single photo/image on the other.

Hero has a faded, dim diagonal stripe graphic behind the headline.

8954d0cc30ddaa76.statement: Section headings carry a short accent underline bar beneath the text (e.g., orange or yellow).

fa72ae9cdf337879.statement: Section backgrounds alternate between cream and a pale tint (mint/sage green) to separate content bands.
Sections alternate between dark navy and light (white/grey/pale) background bands.

Section backgrounds alternate among several varied colors (cream, white, gradient, slate, near-black, mint, dark teal) to separate content.
Sections alternate between white and pale blue-gray/tinted background bands, with a dark navy footer.
Off-white cream/beige or peach-tinted background bands separate sections from white areas.
Off-white cream page background with a dark green hero band and header/footer bands.

5c8fe9439c46bde1.statement: Palette is a navy/dark-blue scheme with blue and white, plus bright or warm accent colors (amber, yellow, red, magenta, brick-red).

Palette mixes near-black text with saturated earthy accent blocks (teal, sage, tan, orange) and warm off-white panels.

89ce974ae8aab820.statement: Cards place square-cropped images above text, with uniform sizing regardless of natural aspect ratio.
Promo images sit in white padded bordered card frames with generous spacing between them.

972b46a3babda65f.statement: Page title combines the brand name with a descriptive tagline (e.g., separated by a pipe, dash, or em dash) rather than being a bare brand or keyword string.

Footer is dark navy or dark with light text and white column headings in multiple columns.

Footer is a multi-column directory with uppercase letter-spaced headings and plain text links, with a bottom bar below a divider.

Footer is a dark navy band with repeated white logo, white text and underlined links.

b7a78a14c1793bc1.statement: Page background is a warm off-white cream rather than pure white or black.

Section headings are mid-size at regular weight rather than bold.
Headings are large and semibold, with a very large hero h1 and a bigger h2 scale.

Headings use a Georgia-style serif at regular weight instead of bold sans-serif.
Uses a generic system sans-serif font stack (system-ui/Helvetica Neue/Arial) rather than a custom web font or the browser default serif.
Sans-serif Helvetica Neue/Arial font stack, with large light-weight display headline.
Single neo-grotesque sans-serif typeface (Helvetica Neue) used throughout.

9560430ca1c35094.statement: Headings and navigation labels use title or sentence case rather than all-caps/uppercase.

a77d8d0211d0b79f.statement: Body text is slightly larger (about 17px) with generous line height (about 1.6–1.65).

Body text uses a tighter line height, about 1.65, on a 16px or 17px base.
Body text is 16px with roomy line height, and h2 headings are larger and bolder.
Body text is a near-black, navy-tinted dark rather than mid-gray.
Base body text is a standard 16px with compact line height and small h2 sizes.

10e9c5f9250b0223.statement: Buttons are fully rounded pills, in filled primary and outlined secondary variants.

6c4c6087ce13cbaa.statement: Hero is centered with an intro paragraph, a pill search bar with suggestion chips, and two CTA buttons.
Hero is a solid green panel with white headline, intro paragraphs, two CTA buttons and an enlarged badge image in a white circle.
Hero is a muted gradient panel with a very large white headline and an outlined button.

92d5bed298b1f3be.statement: Links end with a right-arrow glyph (→) as a trailing affordance, such as 'View all' or 'More →' links.
In-text links are blue without underline.

Quick links are presented as a single horizontal row with a small uppercase label.
Navigation links are title-case dark text without dropdown carets, on the same row as the logo.
Navigation links are plain white text in the top bar, without decorative strips.

9baa89595834329e.statement: Content is arranged in multi-column grids of equal-sized cards (rows of cards, often bordered, with arrows, icons or images).

Rounded corners and large radii are applied widely across cards, buttons and containers.

b2f80f9d15c3af66.statement: Heading hierarchy is clean and properly nested: a single h1, h2 section titles, h3 for cards or items, and h4 for footer or sub-groups.

Deep heading outline with many h2/h3/h4 headings used for product names, collections and footer columns.

d24deb2828531aae.statement: Icons are plain text glyphs or characters (arrows, ☰) rather than SVG, image, sprite, or icon-font icons.

c36808966ac9627c.statement: Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox.
Layout uses CSS grid and flexbox within a narrower centered content container.
Centered content container of roughly 1120px, using CSS grid.
Layout uses CSS grid with comparatively few flex containers.
Layout relies mainly on CSS grid for multi-column arrangements.
Layout relies on flexbox and grid, with a taller, airier page and generous whitespace.
Layout is a single centered column of stacked full-width sections, with grid used for card rows.
Layout uses CSS grid for some content and has a clean slider with non-overlapping slides.

9de507c93b8f9943.statement: Long words in narrow cards can wrap or break mid-word, creating awkward line breaks.
Long answer paragraphs span the full card width, producing long line lengths.

06919a6187fa69da.statement: Content sits in a centered, constrained/max-width container with generous side margins/gutters rather than running full width.
Page uses a styled magazine-style layout with a centered container and a right sidebar column beside the main content.
Content is aligned to a consistent left edge (including headings and intro paragraphs) across sections.

ebb4f4b18e785f9c.statement: Newsletter signup is a standalone section with a prominent email input and a green button.
Newsletter is a large green rounded panel with an email input and Subscribe button.
Newsletter signup is a standalone white section with an H2, a rounded input and an orange pill button.
Newsletter signup is a rounded input with inline white pill button on a dark colored band.
Newsletter signup is a minimal single email input with a rounded/pill button, inline or centered.
Newsletter signup is a centered horizontal inline form row.
Newsletter form joins a dark-bordered input and black submit button in one inline row.
Page has minimal forms and controls, with a single signup form and one input.

04d0fb827670d533.statement: Small uppercase, letter-spaced eyebrow/kicker labels sit above section headings or titles.
Small labels, nav items, links and headings use tracked, letterspaced uppercase text.
Card and post titles are bold in sentence or title case, while eyebrows, labels and sources are uppercase and tracked.
Social icons are small images placed inside white circular badges.
Category icons are small and left-aligned, with small bold letter-spaced uppercase blue labels.
Top navigation labels are title case, small, and grouped beside the logo.
Navigation labels use title case, and dropdown items carry small caret indicators.

09e41fd9c80bde84.statement: Page uses a dark theme with dark navy/near-black background and near-white text.
Hero background is a gradient (e.g., navy or blue to cyan) with prominent white headline text over it.
Photo/artwork backgrounds are darkened or overlaid with dark tints, with white text on top.
Hero is a static dark textured background with left-aligned text, without a carousel or pagination dots.

29428bfc665e1e31.statement: Head includes charset, viewport and description meta tags.
Head includes a charset meta and a descriptive meta description, with little other verification or cache metadata.

b13f5fbef49a8438.statement: Text-heavy content sits in a narrow centred white card with left-aligned lines.
Content blocks are white bordered rounded cards with an icon beside a heading and text, ending in a 'Read More →' link on its own line.
Statistics appear as white rounded cards with colored numerals and sentence-case gray captions.
Text uses two tones: white headings and muted blue-grey body copy on dark cards.
Text-only cards are white cards with an accent-colored left border.
Location items are white rounded bordered cards containing image and text on a gray background, with bold navy names.
Cards use left-aligned text over a darkening gradient overlay, with top rules on journal cards.
Card titles and captions are left-aligned, bold or semibold, in sentence or title case rather than uppercase centered labels.

537c946647f412fc.statement: Flat styling with no box shadows, gradients or animations.
Decoration is minimal: a single gradient and one box shadow, with no transitions, animations or transforms.

49b39b553ca74907.statement: Typography relies solely on a system-ui font stack, with no web fonts or icon fonts.
Typography uses a single system sans-serif font (Trebuchet MS) with no custom web fonts or icon fonts.
Typography uses only the system-ui font stack, with slightly larger 16px body text and looser line height.
Typography uses a system font stack (-apple-system, Arial) rather than a proprietary brand typeface.
Typography is limited to a system sans stack plus one serif, with no custom web fonts.

7e5105c780bbe693.statement: A single warm orange or orange-red accent color is used for CTAs, links, labels, badges, underlines and borders.
A single bright cyan accent color is used for buttons, initials, badges and highlights.

9dd0996eb32a0e20.statement: Announcement appears as a full-width colored strip (rather than a modal box), sometimes with a badge or underlined link.
Announcement bar is near-black with white text.

67f5dedbee3ac071.statement: Intro/about block uses a two-column split layout.
Split sections pair a coloured block with a text column, alternating sides.

f68e5bc4f3b059d7.statement: Corners use consistent moderate radii (roughly 6–15px) with no pill shapes.
Corners are rounded with larger radii and pill shapes, shifting away from square or small-radius corners.
All corners are square, with no rounded elements, pills or circles.

281eb28586e7b968.statement: Primary buttons are solid filled (red/accent) with bold or generous styling.
Filled primary buttons are paired with outlined secondary buttons.

da1059ba9c2cea82.statement: Primary calls to action are solid blue rectangular buttons; secondary actions are outlined rectangular buttons.
Primary calls to action are solid black rectangular buttons, with secondary actions as underlined text links or outlined buttons.

434d6c48622b6d0e.statement: Site name appears as a plain text wordmark in a minimal top navigation bar.
Site name appears as a small two-line serif text logo at top left.

6327b073b2dd166c.statement: Payment logos are shown as a row of small payment-method badges in the footer.

9113716526af3ca4.statement: Quotes are marked up semantically with figure, blockquote and figcaption elements.
Quotes are marked up with blockquote and cite elements rather than figure/figcaption pairs.

ceb622ca310c483a.statement: Page has exactly one h1 containing the hero headline, with a clear heading hierarchy.
Hero h1 is very large, bold, and set as a multi-line tagline (white text, about 61px, wrapping over two lines).
Hero h1 is very large (about 64px) and set as a multi-line uppercase tagline.
Page opens with a hero: large featured image with big serif headline and excerpt, beside a list of small thumbnail posts.
Large single H1 hero headline with centered subtitle and centered stats row beneath.
Hero H1 is very large (~54px), bold, in title case rather than all caps.

60e44d3c2ccb9440.statement: Body text is a near-black charcoal color rather than pure black.
Body text is a green-tinted near-black rather than neutral grey.
Body text uses a blue-tinted dark slate color rather than neutral near-black.
Body text is near-black navy rather than medium gray, giving strong contrast.

5fdff973cde2813e.statement: Corners are generously rounded (roughly 8–16px radii on cards and inputs), with pill shapes on buttons, chips and badges.
Cards and images use small corner radii (1–7px), with only rare pill shapes.

10bfc32d6286327b.statement: Hero image has rounded corners and a soft drop shadow, the only shadowed element.
Hero has a subtle radial colored glow as the only gradient decoration.

ccac524aa3b9d38f.statement: Article titles are bold, dark text without link styling (no blue or underline), rather than default links.
Section titles are bold sans-serif with a thick dark underline rule beneath each.
Headlines and section titles are heavy-weight bold sans-serif (700–900), rather than script lettering or wide tracking.
News headlines are medium-weight sans-serif h4 headings.

9e47fec7feda9c8c.statement: Logo or partner tiles are small with rounded corners (small radius, bordered).

03e6901d2bc3ac3f.statement: Logo is a text wordmark with one word colored in accent blue.
Header logo is a blue gradient rounded-square mark, with links and language toggle grouped at right.

abef68e649632716.statement: Copy uses typographic (curly) apostrophes/quotes and dashes rather than straight ones.
Copy uses em dashes and straight apostrophes for punctuation.

e97779e8e04a640d.statement: Typography uses a single Helvetica Neue-style sans-serif family for all text, including headings.

844ecb83dce1d7df.statement: Topic or suggested links are displayed as pill-shaped chips (outlined or translucent).

2793abc4ba7b049b.statement: Top navigation bar has the logo at left with inline links, and the current or call-to-action item is styled as a pill.

3ed7e88818849d12.statement: Badges (e.g. review counts, 'TRENDING', 'NEW!') are rendered as small accent-colored pill-shaped labels.

e9d6900dc426bcdb.statement: Intro paragraphs (and section headings) are centered in a narrower text column/measure.

700fa1c438f5851b.statement: Includes ARIA attributes for accessibility, such as an accessible hamburger toggle and navigation attributes.
Uses few ARIA attributes, relying on native semantics.

5fea72e01407720f.statement: Defines many CSS transitions/hover effects for interactive states, giving subtle polish.
Few CSS transitions are defined, so interaction animation is minimal.
Photos are shown as CSS background images rather than img elements.

50b664e91945e3e2.statement: List rows are separated by divider rules, with bold headline/title text and an accent-colored link or arrow trailing on the right.

9b000aa11814aace.statement: Social links are plain text labels with no icons or icon glyphs; header and footer use text-only links.
Posts and social content appear as text-only pastel cards with a category label, title and 'read' link, no images.

a8a7995a4bcf5e3c.statement: Page is compact and short, with few sections, less content, and tighter spacing.

241cdbb07e1885d4.statement: Video block has a large thumbnail or panel with a prominent play button.

1a523ae5f8608065.statement: Header is sticky and translucent with a backdrop blur effect.

59a30446fd980716.statement: Visual effects are restrained, with minimal shadows, transitions and animations.
Visual effects favor gradients over shadows, transitions and transforms; decorative dividers are minimal.

49fd8467e6515d2f.statement: Images, tiles and cards have softly rounded corners and no hard outlines or caption bars.

dd0c66a904fc6eb8.statement: Feature sections are laid out as alternating image/text rows in a zig-zag pattern, with the image switching sides from row to row.

1632e53f358d4fb6.statement: Dark navy bands anchor the top of the page, with a dark top bar sitting above or within a navy header/nav area.

f6f2cab14029be32.statement: Promos appear as cards with distinct styling per card, left-aligned text and an arrow text link.
Promos appear as equal-sized bordered cards with image on top and red uppercase titles below.

1129a64ef41ca024.statement: Contact details appear as plain visible text rather than a form.

Contact details are wrapped in a semantic address element.

0d82aa827d26fd9a.statement: Forms use native/semantic controls with explicit label elements for inputs.

cbcf84b924129fbb.statement: Accent color is a hot pink/pinkish crimson used for small text highlights, buttons and key heading words.

3eabb53eb890c59a.statement: Separation relies on 1px borders and flat panels, with no drop shadows.

97804868b16349ec.statement: Uses minimal semantic DOM with landmarks (nav, main, sections/header/footer) and few wrappers, scripts and inline styles.

6c4f4d0476a0b7f9.statement: Footer is minimal and slim, with little content and no dense legal text or social icons.

e2bea62b953b5437.statement: Navigation bar is semi-transparent with backdrop blur, with a compact logo and labelled 'Menu' toggle button.
Navigation is placed inline on the same light header row as the logo, with the menu toggle styled as a transparent button.
